what_is_it.explanation: Open Lakehouse Compute Fabric (OLCF) is a platform that provides workspaces, lakehouses, a SQL editor, dashboards, and Jupyter-compatible notebooks across local laptops, on-premises machines, cloud VMs, or Kubernetes. It includes a worker agent system that forms an Apache Spark Standalone cluster and features a Microsoft Fabric compute extension allowing remote execution from Fabric notebooks directly to your own Spark environment. Additionally, it offers OLCF Intelligence for data lineage and an MCP endpoint for AI agents.
what_is_it.one_line: An open-source lakehouse platform featuring a Microsoft Fabric Compute Extension and multi-machine compute fabric.
